8 GB is the minimum. For Android, we rec: 8 GB is the minimum. For Android, we recommend at least 32 GB. 128 GB is the sweet spot for Android and EASYROMS to fit comfortably. Smaller cards can work if they meet the 8 GB minimum.
An existing andr36oid card may identify: An existing andr36oid card may identify its selected profile. For a new card, use your console’s board markings and the panel information from its supplier. Similar-looking R36S consoles can have different wiring. Choose the board family first; a panel number alone is not enough. If your console is missing here, this release does not ship its profile.
Android is much heavier on storage than: Android is much heavier on storage than ArkOS and similar Linux firmware. Use a high-quality, fast microSD card for a smooth experience.
Apps, settings, saves, and games will be: Apps, settings, saves, and games will be preserved.
BOOT, system, and vendor will be updated: BOOT, system, and vendor update together. The dedicated cache partition gets cleared. Userdata and games stay in place. We’ll save a recovery backup before writing.
Check the selected image and card, then: Check the selected image and card, then try again.
Choose a release to see its supported co: Choose a release to see its supported consoles and panels.
Choose the recovery.json file saved by t: Choose the recovery.json file saved by the interrupted update.
Choose your release and console. We’ll p: Choose your release and console. We’ll prepare the card and check the result.
Connect a USB SD-card adapter directly. Internal SD slots, USB hubs, hard drives, and SSDs are not supported.
Connect a USB card reader directly to yo: Connect a USB card reader directly to your Android device. You don’t need root.
Custom DTBs must be built specifically f: Custom DTBs must be built specifically for andr36oid. DTBs from other custom firmwares are unlikely to work.
Each block summarizes a region of the ca: Each block summarizes a region of the card. Preserved regions are never written.
Everything currently on this card will b: Everything currently on this card will be erased.
For a new installation, everything on th: For a new installation, everything on the selected card will be erased. An update preserves apps, settings, saves, and the games partition.

Insert a card with 512-byte logical sect: Insert a card with 512-byte logical sectors and try again.

Keep the card connected until the operat: Keep the card connected until the operation finishes.

Low-quality cards can fail early, behave: Low-quality cards can fail early, behave unpredictably, cause crashes, or corrupt data.
No disk images are attached to andr36oid: No disk images are attached to andr36oid/releases yet. You can choose an image from disk.
No removable cards found. Insert a card: No removable cards found. Insert a card and refresh.
Only Treble images can be installed. Eac: Only Treble images can be installed. We check each download before writing to the card.
Only the Android DTB is replaced. The se: Only the Android DTB is replaced. The selected shipped profile still supplies the bootloader display files. Continue only if this DTB was made for your console and this release.
Preparing to write. Keep the card connec: Preparing to write. Keep the card connected.
Restore the saved operating system? User: Restore the saved operating system? Userdata and games remain protected.
Safely eject the card and insert it into: Safely eject the card and insert it into the console’s system card slot. The first boot prepares storage and restarts the console. Keep it powered on until Android setup appears. If the screen stays blank, check the chosen board and panel profile.
Select the card that was being updated f: Select the card that was being updated first.

USB access uses libaums and libusb, the: USB access uses libaums and libusb, the same USB stack used by EtchDroid.
Unchecked: reserve 16 GiB for Android an: Unchecked: reserve 16 GiB for Android and use the remaining space for a games partition readable on your computer. Updates keep the existing arrangement.

Use your console’s board markings and sc: Use your console’s board markings and screen information. Similar-looking consoles can require different DTBs.
